plan.headline: Your Date at Zhang Liang Mala Tang, Chinatown (Nankin Row)
plan.timing: This islandwide chain delivers predictable comfort, so book any weeknight and grab a booth where you can both watch the broth boil.
plan.order: Order the mala bone broth and tomato base — split the difference on their dry-vs-soup standoff, then load both with beef tripe, duck blood, pork intestine, and lotus root at full numbing throttle.
plan.conversationStarter: If you could only eat one of these four forever — tripe, intestine, lotus root, or duck blood — which would you pick and why?
